Contact us

Emergencies on campus

  • Call +44 (0) 118 378 6300 in the case of an emergency on campus. The University Security Team will be able to assist you in contacting the emergency services if necessary.
  • Call +44 (0) 118 378 7799 for any other non-emergency campus security concerns.

Report and Support

If you experience or witness an incident within the University community, you can report this either with your details or anonymously using our Report and Support website.

Are you concerned about a student?

If you are concerned about a student’s welfare and think they need support, please call +44 (0) 118 378 4777. The Welfare Team is available Monday to Friday, 10:00-16:00.
If they are living in halls, you can also contact the relevant Hall Warden.

have a neighbourhood query or issue?

If you have a neighbourhood complaint, please email at community@reading.ac.uk, or call +44 (0) 118 378 3279 or +44 (0) 118 378 3577. Our Community Relations Team is also available to answer any questions about our community activity.

Visit the university

Check our Open Days and visiting section to find out about campus tours, virtual events and dates of our Open Days.

Ask us a question

If you have any questions about study at Reading, please submit an enquiry. If you would like a copy of our prospectus, please fill out our request form.

Student Services

The Student Services Reception Team are based in the Carrington building and can be contacted at +44 (0) 118 378 5555 or studenthelp@reading.ac.uk.
For more information about the support services in the Carrington building, please visit the Student Services page.

International support

For Immigration or Home Office Compliance enquiries, please email immigration@reading.ac.uk and for general enquiries please email Int.Adv@reading.ac.uk, or phone +44 (0)118 378 8038. Please visit the International Students pages to discover the support available to our international students.

Careers

The Careers team helps students and graduates find work. You can reach them by emailing careers@reading.ac.uk or calling +44 (0) 118 378 8359. Please visit the Careers website for further information about the services available.

If you have queries related to working at the university, please contact hr@reading.ac.uk.

Events

Visit our Events page to see what's on at the University of Reading. You can also email the Events team at events@reading.ac.uk or call +44 (0) 118 378 6718.

If you have queries relating to visiting the university and Open Days, please visit the Open Days and visiting page.

Graduation

The Graduation Office is available Monday to Friday, 10:00-16:00, on +44 (0)118 378 5500. You can also get in touch with the Graduation team via email at graduation@reading.ac.uk.

Hire a venue

Visit Venue Reading to explore hospitality at the University and hire our venues. The Venue Reading team is available at info@venuereading.com or +44 (0) 118 378 5657.

Accommodation

The Accommodation Office team is available Monday to Friday, 08:30-17:00, on +44 (0) 118 200 5011 or via email at accommodationonline@reading.ac.uk. For more information please visit the Accommodation website.

Accounts Payable

If you're a supplier, please send any invoice-related query to invoices@reading.ac.uk, or call Accounts Payable on +44 (0) 118 378 8104. If you're using the E-Marketplace system, you can check the status of your invoices by logging into your personal supplier account.

Procurement

If you're a current or potential supplier, you can email the Procurement Team at procurement@reading.ac.uk or call +44 (0) 118 378 8305.
Please visit the Information for suppliers page to find out more about our processes and terms and conditions.

Human Resources

Our Human Resources team are available at hr@reading.ac.uk or on +44 (0) 118 378 8751, Monday to Friday, 9 am - 3 pm.
If you need more information, please visit the HR Contact Information page.
